headers.Subject:
[PATCH v2 01/11] ASoC: dt-bindings: qcom,
 apr: Add GLINK channel name for SM8450
headers.List-Id:
"Alsa-devel mailing list for ALSA developers -
 http://www.alsa-project.org" <alsa-devel.alsa-project.org>

content:
On SM8450 and SC8280XP with Qualcomm GPR, the GLINK channel name
(qcom,glink-channels) for ADSP is "adsp_apps".

Signed-off-by: Krzysztof Kozlowski <krzysztof.kozlowski@linaro.org>

---

Cc: quic_srivasam@quicinc.com
Cc: quic_plai@quicinc.com
---
 .../devicetree/bindings/soc/qcom/qcom,apr.yaml        | 11 +++++++++--
 1 file changed, 9 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
diff:
diff --git a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/soc/qcom/qcom,apr.yaml b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/soc/qcom/qcom,apr.yaml
index f47491aab3b1..0a7a34cb2497 100644
--- a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/soc/qcom/qcom,apr.yaml
+++ b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/soc/qcom/qcom,apr.yaml
@@ -58,8 +58,7 @@ properties:
   qcom,glink-channels:
     $ref: /schemas/types.yaml#/definitions/string-array
     description: Channel name used for the communication
-    items:
-      - const: apr_audio_svc
+    maxItems: 1
 
   qcom,intents:
     $ref: /schemas/types.yaml#/definitions/uint32-array
@@ -203,7 +202,15 @@ allOf:
             - qcom,gpr
     then:
       properties:
+        qcom,glink-channels:
+          items:
+            - const: adsp_apps
         power-domains: false
+    else:
+      properties:
+        qcom,glink-channels:
+          items:
+            - const: apr_audio_svc
 
   - if:
       required:
